key_responsibilities: Design, develop, and maintain scalable software applications and services using modern frameworks and languages.
Write clean, well-tested code and participate in code reviews to maintain code quality standards.
Collaborate with product managers, designers, and other engineers to define and deliver features.
Build and optimize APIs, backend services, and user-facing features across the full stack.
Troubleshoot, debug, and optimize application performance and database queries.
Contribute to system architecture and technical design discussions.
Utilize version control (GitHub) and maintain CI/CD best practices.

company_research.culture_signals: Inclusive, supportive team environment; mentorship from experienced senior developers; opportunities to lead projects and grow into mid-level roles.
